app/org.snitchwatch.Snitchwatch/x86_64/m.--show-metadata:
[Application]
name=org.snitchwatch.Snitchwatch
runtime=org.kde.Platform/x86_64/6.11
sdk=org.kde.Sdk/x86_64/6.11
command=snitchwatch-kirigami

[Context]
shared=ipc;
sockets=fallback-x11;wayland;
devices=dri;
filesystems=/run/snitchwatch:ro;xdg-config/kdeglobals:ro;/run/snitchwatch-auth:ro;xdg-config/snitchwatch:create;
persistent=.local/share/snitchwatch;.local/state/snitchwatch;

[Session Bus Policy]
com.canonical.AppMenu.Registrar=talk
org.kde.kconfig.notify=talk
org.kde.KGlobalSettings=talk
org.kde.StatusNotifierWatcher=talk
org.freedesktop.Notifications=talk

[Environment]
SNITCHWATCH_SYSTEM_BRIDGE=1

[Extension org.snitchwatch.Snitchwatch.Debug]
directory=lib/debug
autodelete=true
no-autodownload=true

[Build]
built-extensions=org.snitchwatch.Snitchwatch.Debug;
